privacy: Helper pack is source-only and outside Git. Profile, certificates, identity outputs and raw signing logs stay in explicitly bound private/owned roots.

Current authorization must be captured per artifact; historical authorization is not replayed.
status: portable controls passed; actual candidate assembly/signing and artifact authority admission unperformed

source_pack.retention: Keep while any package consumer uses this exact source pack; copied sources retain original notices. No private signing key or profile is part of the pack.

binding_api.read_only: inspect_inputs / signing_plan verify input refs, passed recipe/source-pinned receipts, unique artifact owners, whole parent bundle and native closure. They grant no permission.
binding_api.execution: assemble requires an owned worker process group, live interval, static reviewed signing recipe and matching fresh running operation binding {path,operation_id}. It captures current authority before codesign.
binding_api.current_admission: verify_current_authority requires independently reviewed runtime_ref and explicit operation_ref, checks their noncircular UUID/output/hash/completed-operation join, then captures current authority and signatures. Pinned operation bytes are rechecked afterward.
binding_api.recipe_review: Pinned public recipe + bindings; file digest for Wine/graphics, explicit independently reviewed expanded digest + exact public/bindings/private-manifest receipt refs for FEX. Receipt never supplies its own expected hash.
binding_api.worker: execute owns a process group and fixed current global flock; bounded request parsing precedes the whole-operation deadline; owned command cleanup may take an additional five-second reap wait.
binding_api.component_operation: Each build.json must join its sibling component operation.json by operation_id/scope/released=true. Its exact ref is a pre/post input and is retained in development_assembly.

Capture and recheck exact assembly/core/helper/build/error/provenance source refs before and after operations; phase wall/monotonic times and original failures remain in private receipts. New candidate records explicitly deny runtime qualification and execution authorization.

CLI execution adds a fresh task-owned operation receipt, static request/source refs, current fixed flock, aggregate worker log bound and whole-operation timer. Original bundle cp uses the existing bounded owned-command transport. Secondary log/reap evidence failures do not mask an existing command failure.

Inner assembly success is distinct from final worker success. Runtime binds canonical operation path/UUID; final worker receipt binds exact runtime_ref. Current admission requires an explicit reviewed operation_ref and rejects failed, unfinalized, mismatched or changed operations. Component release records are joined by operation_id and rechecked.

storage_estimate.method: Full logical parent bundle copy plus positive replacement growth, one largest native rewrite, all bounded command logs including read overshoot, certificate extraction and signature allowance, code-page allowance and metadata. No APFS sharing assumed. Recompute at admission; retain at least 6 GiB floor. CLI adds the requested aggregate worker log bound and one MiB operation metadata to the candidate estimate; bounded copy logs are included.
storage_estimate.release_conditions: Parent retains old runtime and all selected inputs. New failed candidates and logs remain until review determines retention; this package performs no deletion.
